tbsnews.net/features/panorama/what-drivi.title: What is driving Bangladesh’s rising juvenile crime?
tbsnews.net/features/panorama/what-drivi.excerpt:
The murder of 13-year-old Ishayat Shahriar Apratim in Cumilla has renewed concerns over the vulnerability of children to violence and juvenile crime in Bangladesh.

As questions grow over what led to his death, the case has also brought wider concerns about adolescent gang culture, family and social environments, school intervention, online influences and the limits of law enforcement into sharper focus.

Experts spoke to TBS to examine what is driving juvenile crime, why gang culture is taking root among adolescents and what families, schools, communities, and the state need to do before vulnerable children are drawn into serious violence.

fed_rate_decision_inflation_jobs.headline: Fed Faces Inflation Decision After Strong August Jobs Report
fed_rate_decision_inflation_jobs.summary: A surprising rise in August nonfarm payrolls and steady unemployment revives expectations of a rate hike, but the Fed will still base its decision on upcoming inflation data.
highlights: August nonfarm payrolls topped Bloomberg estimates
Unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%
Rate hike not guaranteed as inflation data remains decisive

hon_hai_sales_ai_server.headline: Hon Hai Sales Surge 52% Fueled by Nvidia AI Server Demand
hon_hai_sales_ai_server.summary: Hon Hai Precision Industry reported August revenue of NT$921.8 billion, a 52% sales jump driven by soaring global demand for Nvidia‑powered AI servers.
highlights: July sales grew 54% year‑on‑year, maintaining the rapid growth trend
Analysts expected only about 37% sales growth for the September quarter

ukraine_unit_acquisition_outpost.headline: Leonardo CEO Views Ukraine Unit as Acquisition Outpost
ukraine_unit_acquisition_outpost.summary: Leonardo CEO Lorenzo Mariani said the new Kyiv unit will serve as a hub to scout and acquire innovative Ukrainian defence startups and SMEs.
highlights: Leonardo plans to use its Kyiv unit to identify acquisition targets in Ukraine’s defence tech sector
The Ukrainian ecosystem of SMEs and startups is delivering tested, innovative solutions for military use

maersk_wants_to_invest_in_bangladesh_s_s.headline: Maersk eyes investment in Bangladesh shipbuilding and recycling
maersk_wants_to_invest_in_bangladesh_s_s.summary: Maersk is considering direct investment in Bangladesh’s shipbuilding and ship‑recycling sectors, aiming to turn the country into a hub for new vessels and environmentally compliant dismantling.
highlights: Maersk discussed investment with Commerce Minister Khandakar Abdul Muktadir and Denmark’s Ambassador Christian Brix Møller
Bangladesh could become a hub for recycling ageing vessels and constructing new ships
The proposed investment may bring capital, technology and skills to the local maritime industry

mncs_must_come_to_capital_market_bsec_ch.headline: BSEC Chairman Calls on Multinationals to List on Bangladesh Stock Market
mncs_must_come_to_capital_market_bsec_ch.summary: BSEC chief Masud Khan urged large local and multinational firms to join the capital market, offering voluntary incentives and legal powers to enforce listings.
highlights: BSEC plans to target several flagship companies for listing within the next six months to a year
New mechanisms such as direct listing, hybrid listing, and an extended audit system are being introduced to speed up IPOs
Institutional investors like provident funds will be encouraged to increase participation in equities and corporate bonds

vanguard_rupali_bank_fund_sets_oct_26_sg.institution: Vanguard Asset Management Ltd / Investment Corporation of Bangladesh
vanguard_rupali_bank_fund_sets_oct_26_sg.headline: Vanguard Rupali Bank Fund Plans Open-End Conversion at Oct 26 SGM
vanguard_rupali_bank_fund_sets_oct_26_sg.summary: The trustee board approved converting the closed-end Vanguard Rupali Bank Balanced Fund to an open-end scheme, with unitholders voting at an Oct 26 special meeting.
highlights: SGM set for 26 October 2026 at 11:00 am in Dhaka’s RAOWA Convention Hall
Record date fixed 4 October 2026; trading of units will be suspended pending voter list
First‑half 2026 earnings per unit rose to Tk1.19 from a Tk0.57 loss year‑on‑year

govt_bank_borrowing_exceeds_target.headline: Bangladesh Government Bank Borrowing Surpasses FY26 Target by Tk 47,500 cr
govt_bank_borrowing_exceeds_target.summary: Government net borrowing from banks hit Tk 165,538 crore in FY26, far above the revised target, as tax collection fell short and foreign financing slipped.
highlights: Borrowing rose to Tk 165,538 crore, exceeding the revised plan by Tk 47,538 crore
Public‑sector credit grew 30 percent while private‑sector credit rose only 4.47 percent
Analysts warn high government borrowing may crowd out private loans and lift interest rates

garment_import_ban_appeal.headline: BGMEA and BKMEA urge withdrawal of knit fabric import ban
garment_import_ban_appeal.summary: The garment and knitwear associations warned that the new ban on knit fabric imports could disrupt RMG factories, hinder buyer demands, and exacerbate existing gas shortages.
highlights: Sub‑clause 12 of Clause 25 prohibits all knit fabric imports under the Import Policy Order 2026‑2029.
BGMEA and BKMEA say the ban threatens supply of specialised fabrics needed for international orders.
Imported knit fabric shipments have arrived at Chattogram Port and are stuck in open storage.

bkmea_urges_repeal_of_knit_fabric_import.headline: BKMEA Demands Immediate Repeal of Knit Fabric Import Ban
bkmea_urges_repeal_of_knit_fabric_import.summary: The Bangladesh Knitwear Manufacturers and Exporters Association urged the government to withdraw the 2026‑29 import policy ban on knit fabrics, citing gas shortages and export risks.
highlights: The ban is codified in sub‑clause 12 of provision 25 of the 2026‑29 Import Policy Order.
BKMEA reports that many knit fabric shipments have already arrived at Chittagong Port under letters of credit.
Enforcement could cause customs delays, financial losses and cancellation of export orders.

waller_disinflation_plea.headline: Fed Governor Waller Urges Patience as He Mulls Rate Hold in Disinflation Fight
waller_disinflation_plea.summary: Governor Christopher Waller indicated the Fed may keep the policy rate between 3.50% and 3.75% this month, urging markets to allow disinflation to take effect.
highlights: Waller said a September rate hike remains possible if inflation does not ease
He emphasized that inflation dynamics, not just headline numbers, drive his policy stance
He is open to maintaining the current rate range pending supportive data

gas_crisis_ceramics_industry.headline: Bangladesh Ceramics Industry Crippled by Gas Shortages, Production Falls to 35%
gas_crisis_ceramics_industry.summary: Severe gas shortages have forced over 30 ceramics factories to operate at less than half capacity, slashing output to about 35% and threatening exports.
highlights: Gas pressure has dropped from the required 15 PSI to as low as 3–4 PSI, with occasional zero pressure.
Major producers such as RAK Ceramics and Great Wall have shut units, leaving many workers on leave.

knit_fabric_import_ban.institution: Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association (BGMEA)
knit_fabric_import_ban.headline: Bangladesh Halts Knit Fabric Imports, Exporters Warn Export Decline
knit_fabric_import_ban.summary: The government’s new Import Policy Order bans most knit fabric imports, sparking fears that reduced raw material access could curb Bangladesh’s $39 billion apparel exports.
highlights: BGMEA and BKMEA have petitioned the commerce minister to withdraw the ban
The policy permits only specialised fabrics like man‑made fibre and technical textiles with exporter recommendation and

eu_trade_ties_discussion.headline: Bangladesh Seeks Deeper EU Trade Ties Amid Non‑Tariff Barrier Talks
eu_trade_ties_discussion.summary: Bangladesh and EU ministers met in Dhaka to negotiate removal of remaining non‑tariff barriers, preserve EU market access after LDC graduation, and consider full foreign ownership in logistics.
highlights: EU identified 52 non‑tariff barriers; Bangladesh has addressed 40
Proposal to allow 100% foreign ownership in the logistics sector
Government aims to digitise customs with a National Single Window to cut clearance delays

bond_crisis_centralbanks.headline: Central Banks Intervene as Bond Market Crisis Looms, Scope Ratings Warns
bond_crisis_centralbanks.summary: Scope Ratings' Eiko Sievert says a bond market crisis is confirmed when central banks can no longer avoid stepping in to stabilize turmoil.
highlights: Scope Ratings flags central bank intervention as the definitive signal of a bond crisis.
Analyst Eiko Sievert, former FCA and ECB official, emphasizes the loss of policy autonomy as a red flag.

fed_governors_blackout.headline: Fed Governors Meet Bankers During Blackout Periods
fed_governors_blackout.summary: Two Federal Reserve governors attended private banking events during mandated blackout periods, raising questions about compliance with meeting restrictions ahead of the June FOMC decision.
highlights: Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman met with the head of the Massachusetts Bankers Association before the June 16‑17 FOMC
The meetings occurred despite blackout rules that limit interactions with financial firms

ai_stock_bullish.headline: Traders Turn to Bullish Chinese Stock Derivatives as AI Alternative
ai_stock_bullish.summary: Investors are shifting from crowded AI bets in Korea and Japan to bullish Chinese equity derivatives, targeting CSI mid‑ and small‑cap indexes.
highlights: Barclays Plc and UBS Group AG report rising client demand for bullish options on CSI indexes
Derivatives focus on mid‑ and small‑cap Chinese stocks as an alternative to AI‑heavy markets

governor_appointment_upheld.headline: High Court rejects challenge to Mostaqur Rahman's appointment as Bangladesh Bank governor
governor_appointment_upheld.summary: The High Court dismissed a writ contesting the removal of Ahsan H Mansur and the appointment of Md Mostaqur Rahman as Bangladesh Bank governor, upholding the government's decision.
highlights: The petition argued the removal violated the Bangladesh Bank Order, 1972.
The bench hearing the case comprised Justices Khizir Ahmed Choudhury and AF Saiful Karim.

eu_non_tariff_barriers_cleared.headline: Bangladesh Clears 48 EU Non‑Tariff Barriers, 13 Remain
eu_non_tariff_barriers_cleared.summary: Bangladesh has resolved 48 of 61 EU‑identified non‑tariff barriers, while coordinated efforts continue to address the remaining 13 issues.
highlights: Licence renewal hurdles for 100% foreign‑owned logistics firms were lifted
Import sample allowance doubled from $10,000 to $20,000
Customs valuation now uses smart‑card scanning for export traceability

dsex_falls_103_points.headline: DSEX plunges 103 points as heavy selling pressure hits market
dsex_falls_103_points.summary: The DSE benchmark DSEX fell 103 points, or 1.83%, to 5,558 amid sharply negative breadth and a 24% drop in daily turnover.
highlights: DSEX down 103 points (1.83%) to close at 5,558
DS30 slipped 24 points to 2,116
Turnover fell 24% to Tk545 crore as 348 stocks declined

private_placements_38_7bn.headline: China's AgBank and ICBC Target $38.7 Billion in Private Placements
private_placements_38_7bn.summary: Agricultural Bank of China aims to raise 160 billion yuan and ICBC 100 billion yuan via A‑share placements, with the finance ministry subscribing to most of the issue.
highlights: The Ministry of Finance will subscribe for 130 billion yuan of AgBank’s placement.
It will also subscribe for 70 billion yuan of ICBC’s placement.

spring_property_season_down.headline: Australian Spring Property Auctions Down 31% From 2025
spring_property_season_down.summary: Australian spring auctions saw nearly 1,500 homes listed, a 31% drop from last year, while clearance rates remained broadly steady despite recent tax changes.
highlights: Almost 1,500 homes were auctioned, 31% fewer than in 2025
Auction clearance rates stayed roughly unchanged
The slowdown follows May property‑tax reforms

oil_output_policy_october.headline: OPEC+ Holds October Oil Output Policy Steady Amid Iran Conflict
oil_output_policy_october.summary: OPEC+ ministers kept October quotas unchanged as the Iran war disrupts shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, limiting the group’s influence on market prices.
highlights: Seven core members—Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Oman—met on 6 September.
OPEC+ completed a phased rollback of a 1.65 million‑barrel‑per‑day cut for September.
Production cuts remain in place for most members until the end of 2026.

specialised_asset_recovery_agency.headline: Bangladesh Mulls Specialized Agency to Recover Smuggled Assets
specialised_asset_recovery_agency.summary: Finance Minister Amir Khosru announced a plan to create a dedicated authority aimed at retrieving billions of taka laundered abroad and preventing future losses.
highlights: A 12‑member task force led by the Bangladesh Bank governor identified 11 priority money‑laundering cases
Joint Investigation Teams have frozen roughly Tk 76,983.93 crore in assets domestically and overseas

fertiliser_supply_blockade.headline: Bangladeshi Farmers Protest Fertiliser Shortage on Lalmonirhat‑Burimari Highway
fertiliser_supply_blockade.summary: Farmers halted traffic on the Lalmonirhat‑Burimari road, demanding sufficient fertiliser supplies and an end to trade syndicates, before dispersing after local officials promised investigation.
highlights: Blockade lasted about 30 minutes, causing long vehicle queues
Protest took place in front of a Bangladesh Agriculture and Fertilizer Association warehouse in Mahendranagar
Deputy Commissioner Md Rashedul Hoque Prodhan denied any fertiliser shortage in the district

turkey_cuts_2027_gdp_growth_forecast_to_.headline: Turkey Lowers 2027 GDP Growth Forecast to 4.2% Amid Election Uncertainty
turkey_cuts_2027_gdp_growth_forecast_to_.summary: Turkey's Medium‑Term Program now projects 2027 GDP growth at 4.2%, revising the 2026 outlook to 3.3% as political and regional risks rise.
highlights: Forecast for 2027 cut from 4.3% to 4.2%
2026 GDP growth revised down to 3.3% from 3.8%
Revision reflects fallout from the Iran war and upcoming elections

probe_of_uber_s_exit_from_nigeria.headline: Nigeria Antitrust Agency Probes Uber’s Sudden Exit
probe_of_uber_s_exit_from_nigeria.summary: Nigeria’s Federal Competition & Consumer Protection Commission is investigating Uber’s abrupt market withdrawal after the ride‑hailing firm ceased operations without notifying customers.
highlights: Uber halted services in Nigeria last week without prior notice
FCCPC CEO Tunji Bello said the probe will examine unfulfilled customer obligations
The investigation focuses on compliance with competition and consumer‑protection laws

russia_ukraine_exchange_strikes_as_us_en.headline: US Envoys Kushner and Witkoff Head to Kyiv Amid Russia‑Ukraine Strikes
russia_ukraine_exchange_strikes_as_us_en.summary: US officials Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff travel to Kyiv after talks with President Vladimir Putin, as Russia and Ukraine continue nightly missile exchanges.
highlights: Kushner and Witkoff met with President Vladimir Putin in Moscow before heading to Kyiv
A fire broke out at an unidentified facility in Russia’s Ryazan region
Russia and Ukraine exchanged overnight missile strikes throughout the region

agricultural_loan_waiver.headline: Bangladesh Waives Up to Tk10,000 Agricultural Loans for 14.34 Lakh Farmers
agricultural_loan_waiver.summary: Finance Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury announced that 14.34 lakh farmers received loan waivers of up to Tk10,000, with the government disbursing Tk1,352.74 crore to banks.
highlights: The waiver covers interest and principal up to Tk10,000 per farmer
Beneficiaries span all upazilas nationwide
The programme has cost the treasury Tk1,352.74 crore

bad_loan_accumulation.headline: Six State‑Owned Banks Accumulate Tk1.47 Lakh Crore Bad Loans
bad_loan_accumulation.summary: Six state‑owned banks recorded Tk1.47 lakh crore in non‑performing loans by June end, with Janata Bank alone holding over half the total.
highlights: Janata Bank leads with Tk75,396 crore in NPLs
Sector NPL ratio rose to 32.78% of total loans
Government paid Tk1,352.74 crore to settle waived farmer loans

domestic_gas_production_policy.headline: Bangladesh Seeks to Cut Imported Gas, Boost Domestic Production
domestic_gas_production_policy.summary: The government aims to lessen reliance on imported gas by increasing local extraction, seeking a permanent solution to the nation’s ongoing energy shortages.
highlights: Press Secretary Abu Abdullah M Saleh announced the policy at the ERF Language Club inauguration.
Shortages of gas, electricity and fuel oil are interconnected and worsened by supply disruptions in war‑affected exporting

iran_attacks_oil_tankers_sep_2026.headline: Iran Targets Oil Tankers After US Strikes in Hormuz
iran_attacks_oil_tankers_sep_2026.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard Navy announced attacks on three oil tankers and several US-linked vessels after American strikes on Iranian tankers over the weekend.
highlights: The IRGC Navy used an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz for the attacks
Iran also claimed to have struck a US naval drone and an unmanned surface vessel

salvini_proposes_bank_tax_sep_2026.headline: Italy Plans to Tax Bank Profits Like Spain, Says Salvini
salvini_proposes_bank_tax_sep_2026.summary: Vice Premier Matteo Salvini announced Italy will propose a tax on banks' profits, interest income and fees, mirroring Spain's recent policy.
highlights: Salvini praised Spain's bank tax as "intelligent" despite political differences
He pledged to include a similar tax measure in Italy's upcoming budget
The statement was made at the Ambrosetti Forum in Cernobbio

trump_comments_on_cad_usd_imbalance_sep_.headline: Trump Calls Canada‑US Dollar Imbalance Unacceptable
trump_comments_on_cad_usd_imbalance_sep_.summary: President Donald Trump warned on Truth Social that the current disparity between the Canadian dollar and the U.S. dollar cannot continue, urging corrective action.
highlights: Trump labeled the CAD‑USD exchange gap as “unacceptable”.
The comment was posted on his Truth Social platform.

dse_panic_sell_off_wipes_out_tk6_781_cr_.headline: Panic Selling Cripples Dhaka Stock Exchange, DSEX Drops 103 Points
dse_panic_sell_off_wipes_out_tk6_781_cr_.summary: Intense panic selling amid the energy crisis and alleged order interference caused DSE market capitalisation to fall Tk6,781 crore and the DSEX index to plunge 103 points.
highlights: 89% of stocks declined as market capitalisation shrank by Tk6,781 crore
Investors blame the nationwide gas and electricity crisis and alleged exchange interference
DSEX fell over 103 points, its first single‑day drop of that magnitude since June

new_auto_loan_directives_up_to_tk80_lakh.headline: Bangladesh Bank's New Loan Limits Spur Hybrid and EV Demand
new_auto_loan_directives_up_to_tk80_lakh.summary: Banks can now lend up to Tk80 lakh for hybrid and electric cars, prompting a sharp rise in auto‑loan applications and shifting buyer preferences.
highlights: City Bank’s auto‑loan applications jumped 30% in two months, reaching about 600 per month.
Mutual Trust Bank saw an 84% increase in loan files, while BRAC Bank’s disbursements more than doubled year‑on‑year.
Hybrid vehicles now dominate loan applications, outpacing conventional cars.

btrc_urges_google_to_deploy_ai_tools_to_.headline: BTRC Presses Google to Deploy AI for Removing Gambling Content in Bangladesh
btrc_urges_google_to_deploy_ai_tools_to_.summary: The Bangladesh Telecommunication Regulatory Commission urged Google to implement AI-driven tools that instantly detect and delete betting and gambling material from its platforms.
highlights: BTRC also requested Google to set up a local payment system and consider opening a Bangladesh office
Google’s South Asia Policy Head Kyle Gardner said the company will review AI cooperation but noted current constraints on

seriescfunding100m.headline: Google-backed Indian space startup Pixxel raises $100 million in Series C
seriescfunding100m.summary: Pixxel secured $100 million in a Series C round led by Temasek and Seraphim, bringing total funding to $195 million.
highlights: Series C round led by Temasek and Seraphim
Total funding now $195 million, the largest space‑tech raise in India

switzerland_trade_talks.headline: Swiss Ambassador Meets Bangladeshi Minister to Boost Trade and Skills Development
switzerland_trade_talks.summary: Switzerland’s ambassador Reto Renggli met State Minister Humaiun Kobir to explore increased Swiss investment, expand vocational training, and deepen bilateral ties.
highlights: Both sides identified economic partnership as a key pillar of relations
Switzerland supports the voluntary, safe repatriation of Rohingya refugees to Myanmar
Bangladesh’s new embassy in Bern will be operationalised to enhance cooperation

potato_export_drop_49.headline: Bangladesh Potato Exports Halve as Middle East War Spurs Shipping Costs
potato_export_drop_49.summary: Sea‑borne potato shipments fell 49% in FY26, cutting export earnings by 37.8% as container freight rates surged nearly fourfold amid Middle East conflict.
highlights: Malaysia remained the top destination, receiving $3.68 million of potatoes
Exporters cite inadequate cold‑chain storage as a key hurdle

spectrum_management_meeting.headline: Bangladesh Hosts APT Meeting Amid Growing Spectrum Pressure in Asia‑Pacific
spectrum_management_meeting.summary: Bangladesh's hosting of the APT Wireless Group meeting highlights regional challenges of limited spectrum as 5G, 6G and satellite services expand demand.
highlights: Nearly 400 telecom experts gathered in Dhaka for the five‑day AWG‑37 summit.
Bangladesh has about 190 million mobile connections and 110 million 4G subscribers as of July 2026.
The agenda includes spectrum sharing, AI in 6G, and low‑Earth‑orbit satellite communications.

hormuz_traffic_dip_2026.headline: Hormuz traffic falls to ten ships daily after US and Iranian tanker strikes
hormuz_traffic_dip_2026.summary: Average daily transits through the Strait of Hormuz dropped to ten vessels, the lowest level since May, following recent US and Iranian attacks on tankers.
highlights: Transit volume fell from over 15 ships on Friday to ten on Sunday
Only two vessels passed on Saturday, six on Sunday, mainly via the Iranian route

inflation_august_2026.headline: Bangladesh inflation eases to 8.26% in August, food prices slow while non‑food rises
inflation_august_2026.summary: In August 2026, Bangladesh's overall inflation fell to 8.26%, driven by a dip in food inflation to 7.02% despite a rise in non‑food inflation.
highlights: Food inflation dropped to 7.02% from 7.16% in July.
Non‑food inflation rose to 9.32% in August, up from 9.28% in July.

chattogram_port_projects.headline: Three Projects to Modernise Chattogram Port, No Magnama Deep‑Sea Port Planned
chattogram_port_projects.summary: Bangladesh will upgrade Chattogram Port with Laldia Terminal, a new mooring terminal and Bay Terminal, while dismissing any Magnama deep‑sea port scheme.
highlights: Laldia Container Terminal construction started on 30 August on 49.15 acres, slated to operate by 2030 under APM Terminals.
Bay Terminal will handle vessels with 12 m draft and 5,000‑6,000 TEU ships via a PPP model.
Matarbari deep‑sea port, not Magnama, will accommodate 16 m draft and up to 8,200 TEU, adding about 1 million TEUs to capacity.

company_act_modernisation.headline: Bangladesh to Modernise Companies Act with Business Community Input
company_act_modernisation.summary: Commerce Minister Khandakar Abdul Muqtadir announced a draft amendment to the 1994 Companies Act, seeking stakeholder feedback to align the law with modern business needs.
highlights: Draft amendment open for 30‑60 days for businesses to submit comments
BSEC proposes allowing listed companies to buy back shares and modernising annual report terminology
Government aims to align law with international standards to support LDC graduation

economic_issue_threat.headline: Iran Vows Economic War Headquarters Push Amid Threat of Painful Retaliation
economic_issue_threat.summary: Iran announced the creation of an Economic War Headquarters to counter U.S. sanctions while warning that any further attacks will trigger a faster, heavier and more painful response.
highlights: Iran established an Economic War Headquarters to address war‑related economic problems
U.S. strikes hit three Iranian vessels after IRGC launched ballistic missiles at U.S. Navy ships
The preliminary cease‑fire accord reached in June has unraveled, leaving the conflict at a stalemate

energy_taskforce_opposition.headline: Opposition Leader Demands Energy Taskforce as Bangladesh Targets Crisis End by 2030
energy_taskforce_opposition.summary: Shafiqur Rahman urged a joint political‑technical taskforce to address power shortages, meter fees and demand charges while the government pledges to resolve the crisis by 2030.
highlights: Government plans to drill 150 new gas wells and launch an offshore oil‑gas bidding round.
Tk29,000 crore required to abolish meter rental fees and shift consumers to smart prepaid meters by 2030.
Target to generate 5,000 MW of electricity from solar power.

ipo_drought_6months.headline: Bangladesh IPO Drought Persists Six Months into New Government
ipo_drought_6months.summary: Six months after the new government took office, the Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission has yet to approve any new IPOs, extending the market’s capital‑raising drought.
highlights: No company has submitted an IPO application since the BSEC commission took charge in June.
Around Tk1,000 crore of proposed offerings have been withdrawn since March 2024, reducing primary market fundraising.

fsru_investment_interest.headline: US firms eye more FSRU projects in Bangladesh, says ambassador
fsru_investment_interest.summary: US Ambassador Brent Christensen told Commerce Minister Khandakar Abdul Muktadir that American companies are keen to build additional floating storage and regasification units in Bangladesh.
highlights: US firms express strong interest in constructing additional FSRUs in Bangladesh
Bangladesh government gave in‑principle approval to China National Energy Engineering for the third FSRU under a
New policy removes requirement for foreign firms to appoint local agents, increasing procurement transparency

pboc_gold_purchase_2026_09_07.headline: China Central Bank Boosts Gold Reserves Amid Surge in Bullion Prices
pboc_gold_purchase_2026_09_07.summary: In August, the People’s Bank of China added its largest gold stockpile since 2023, even as global bullion prices jumped to multi‑year highs.
highlights: Gold purchases accelerated in August, marking the biggest monthly increase since 2023.
Bullion prices rose sharply, reaching their highest level in over two years.

stocks_oil_inflation_risk_2026_09_07.headline: Asian stocks rise on strong US jobs data, oil climbs amid Gulf tensions
stocks_oil_inflation_risk_2026_09_07.summary: Asian equities rallied on a robust US jobs report that lowered expectations of rate hikes, while oil prices edged higher after US‑Iran maritime clashes.
highlights: Nikkei led gains across Asian markets as shares bounced.
Oil prices rose modestly after US forces and Iran attacked ships in the Gulf.
ECB is expected to raise rates despite market focus on policy guidance.

risk_appetite_bond_yields_2026_09_07.headline: Investors Embrace Risk as Global Bond Yields Keep Rising
risk_appetite_bond_yields_2026_09_07.summary: Despite climbing global bond yields, investors are shifting toward equities and credit markets, buoyed by rising corporate earnings and a stronger risk appetite.
highlights: Equities and high‑yield credit outperformed as earnings growth accelerated
Global sovereign bond yields rose across major markets, yet risk assets kept attracting capital

solar_manufacturing.headline: Walton and PRAN-RFL Launch Domestic Solar Inverter and Battery Production
solar_manufacturing.summary: Amid Bangladesh’s energy crisis, the conglomerates are building local solar inverter and lithium‑ion battery factories to cut imports and meet a 4,000 MW solar target.
highlights: PRAN‑RFL will start a $1 million inverter plant in Narsingdi, aiming for 1,000 units per month.
Walton has completed a lithium‑ion battery plant and will begin inverter production, reducing reliance on $15 million of annual

cross_border_trains.headline: Bangladesh, India to Resume Cross‑Border Passenger Trains by October
cross_border_trains.summary: Bangladesh and India aim to restart three major passenger train routes, including Maitree Express, by October 2026 after a two‑year suspension.
highlights: The annual railway meeting will be held in Dhaka to finalize service arrangements.
Bangladesh may propose a new Rajshahi‑Kolkata train and reroute Maitree Express via Padma Bridge.

foreign_flagged_ships.headline: Foreign‑Flagged Ships Dominate Chattogram Port Trade, Carry 89% of Imports
foreign_flagged_ships.summary: In the first half of 2026, foreign‑flagged vessels handled about 89% of Chattogram Port’s import cargo and 84% of its export cargo.
highlights: Foreign vessels moved 6,22,797 TEUs of imports, representing 89% of total cargo
Bangladesh plans to expand its own fleet to reduce foreign‑currency outflows and create jobs

entry_exams_mandatory_private_banks.headline: Bangladesh Bank Mandates Entry Exams and Certificate Verification for Private Banks
entry_exams_mandatory_private_banks.summary: Private banks must now require written and oral exams for entry‑level hires and verify all educational certificates within a year, tightening merit‑based recruitment.
highlights: Recruitment notices must appear on the bank’s website and in at least two national newspapers.
Higher‑position hires need a competitive process including an oral test and must follow the same verification rules.

withdrawal_duty_free_bonded_import_yarn.headline: Bangladesh Ends Duty‑Free Bonded Yarn Imports to Boost Local Spinning
withdrawal_duty_free_bonded_import_yarn.summary: The National Board of Revenue cancelled duty‑free bonded imports for 10‑30‑count cotton yarn, urging mills to rely on domestic production backed by 100% bank guarantees.
highlights: NBR Order No 51/2026/Customs/519 revoked bonded benefits for HS 5205‑5207 yarn categories.
Genuine exporters may still import yarn with a full bank guarantee.
BTMA expects idle mills to resume production, creating jobs and reducing banks’ non‑performing loans.

workers_incentive_bonus_record_handling.headline: Chattogram Port Workers Receive Tk16.65 crore Incentive Bonus
workers_incentive_bonus_record_handling.summary: The Chattogram Port Authority awarded a Tk16.65 crore incentive bonus, giving each of 6,750 workers Tk25,000 to sustain smooth operations and labour peace.
highlights: Bonus funded entirely by the Chattogram Port Container, Cargo Handling Workers and Employees Welfare Fund
Distribution ceremony held in CPA boardroom with senior officials handing cheques to berth, terminal and ship-handling operators
Incentive aims to maintain uninterrupted port activities amid rising container volumes

yen_7month_high_2026_09_08.headline: Yen climbs to seven‑month high on hawkish BOJ bets, dollar steadies ahead of CPI
yen_7month_high_2026_09_08.summary: The Japanese yen surged to its strongest level in seven months as markets priced in tighter policy from the Bank of Japan, while the U.S. dollar softened before the upcoming consumer price index release.
highlights: Yen reaches a seven‑month peak against the dollar
Traders price in potential BOJ rate hikes
Dollar eases ahead of the U.S. CPI data

gold_decline_fed_rate_hike_2026_09_07.headline: Gold Holds Decline Amid Fed Rate Hike Speculation
gold_decline_fed_rate_hike_2026_09_07.summary: Gold steadied around $4,430 per ounce after a 1% drop, as strong August payrolls revive expectations of a Federal Reserve rate increase next week.
highlights: Gold price hovered near $4,430/oz after a 1% decline
August US job growth surged while unemployment remained steady
Federal Reserve may raise rates at its Sept 15‑16 meeting

bangladesh_bank_appoints_administrator_f.headline: Bangladesh Bank appoints administrator to resolve Fareast Finance crisis
bangladesh_bank_appoints_administrator_f.summary: Bangladesh Bank named Director Md Sadequr Rahman and two associate administrators to manage the resolution of non‑viable NBFI Fareast Finance after its stock trading suspension.
highlights: Director Md Sadequr Rahman was appointed as administrator with Shadril Ahmed and Md Al‑Amin as associate administrators
Fareast Finance was declared non‑viable under the Bank Resolution Act, 2026
The Dhaka Stock Exchange and Chittagong Stock Exchange suspended trading of its shares

dream71_wins_undp_contract_to_develop_st.headline: Bangladesh’s Dream71 Secures UNDP Contract for Timor-Leste Digital Planning System
dream71_wins_undp_contract_to_develop_st.summary: Dream71 Bangladesh Ltd will build a web‑based Strategic Planning and Investment Management Information System for Timor‑Leste’s Ministry of Planning under UNDP’s Pro PALOP‑TL programme.
highlights: System will integrate monitoring of the Strategic Development Plan 2011‑2030, Medium‑Term Plan 2026‑2030, and SDG progress.
Platform features interactive dashboards, offline data entry, role‑based access and automated backup for low‑bandwidth
Project includes six‑month development plus a year of technical support, marking Bangladesh’s expanding ICT export footprint.

customers_withdraw_tk670cr_from_sammilit.headline: Sammilito Islamic Bank Processes Tk670 crore Withdrawals in Two Days
customers_withdraw_tk670cr_from_sammilit.summary: Customers withdrew Tk670 crore from Sammilito Islamic Bank over two days, while withdrawal applications totalled Tk2,345 crore, according to bank sources.
highlights: Around 14,000 customers completed withdrawals, far fewer than the 37,600 applicants
Bangladesh Bank injected Tk5,000 crore to support deposit repayments
The bank was formed by merging five predecessor banks

asia_stocks_yen.headline: Asia stocks waver as yen surges and Iran threatens retaliation
asia_stocks_yen.summary: Asian equity markets slipped modestly on Tuesday as the Japanese yen rallied sharply while Iran warned of possible retaliatory measures against Western sanctions.
highlights: The yen rose to its strongest level in months, pressuring export‑driven stocks.
Iran’s foreign ministry issued a statement warning of counter‑measures if sanctions intensify.

august_pmi_shows_resilience_despite_slow.headline: Bangladesh PMI dips below 50 as manufacturing contracts, agriculture holds steady
august_pmi_shows_resilience_despite_slow.summary: In August, Bangladesh's overall PMI slipped to 49.9, reflecting contraction in manufacturing and services while agriculture expanded for the twelfth month and construction rebounded.
highlights: Manufacturing PMI fell sharply to 47.4, the steepest decline recorded.
Agriculture PMI rose to 56.5, marking a 12th consecutive month of growth.
Construction PMI returned to expansion at 52.4 after previous contraction.

bepza_zone_2_export_debut_50k_machinery_.headline: Bepza Zone‑2 Launches Export with $50,000 Tobacco Machinery Shipment
bepza_zone_2_export_debut_50k_machinery_.summary: Bangladesh’s Bepza Economic Zone‑2 in Mirsharai shipped its first export, a $50,000 tobacco machinery order to Indonesia, signalling the zone’s operational start.
highlights: Export value totals $50,000, the zone’s inaugural overseas shipment.
Lee’s Tobacco Machinery Company Ltd is the first exporter, investing $3.72 million and employing 29 staff.
With this export, Bangladesh now has ten operational Bepza zones, including eight EPZs and two Economic Zones.

tbsnews.net/bangladesh/uae-has-no-inform.headline: UAE Government Says No Evidence Benazir Ahmed Has Left Country
tbsnews.net/bangladesh/uae-has-no-inform.summary: Bangladesh’s Foreign Affairs State Minister Humaiun Kobir told parliament that the UAE has no record of former IGP Benazir Ahmed departing, casting doubt on recent bail rumors.
highlights: Humaiun Kobir confirmed UAE officials are unaware of any departure by Benazir Ahmed.
The UAE handles extradition requests individually, and Bangladesh will maintain diplomatic pressure.

us_cotton_warehouse_launch.headline: Private US Cotton Warehouse Opens in Bangladesh, Cutting Lead Times
us_cotton_warehouse_launch.summary: The new privately run US cotton warehouse in Anwara, Chattogram will let textile mills source cotton locally, slashing 90‑day import lead times and lowering prices.
highlights: Import lead time drops from about 90 days to immediate local delivery.
Warehouse pricing aims to be roughly 10 cents per pound cheaper than current spot rates.
US cotton imports rose to $346 million in FY25, about 10% of Bangladesh’s total cotton imports.

gas_supply_suspension.headline: Gas Supply Suspended for Eight Hours in Dhaka Amid Expressway Project
gas_supply_suspension.summary: Titas Gas will cut service from 1 pm to 9 pm on 10 September in multiple Dhaka neighborhoods to allow pipeline relocation for the Dhaka Elevated Expressway.
highlights: Service interruption will affect residential and commercial customers in ten specified areas of Dhaka.
Customers in nearby zones may experience reduced gas pressure during the work.

tbsnews.net/world/malaysia-helicopter-cr.headline: Helicopter Crash Claims Five Lives in Sarawak, Malaysia
tbsnews.net/world/malaysia-helicopter-cr.summary: A BO-105 helicopter operated by Malaysia’s Flying Doctor Service crashed near Miri, killing a pilot, a doctor, a medical assistant and two nurses.
highlights: The crash occurred about 315 km southeast of Miri in remote Sarawak
All five occupants were confirmed dead by the Fire and Rescue Department and the Ministry of Health
A Civil Aviation Authority investigation team is en route to the site

bangladesh_hong_kong_ippa.institution: Ministry of Industries, Commerce and Textiles
bangladesh_hong_kong_ippa.headline: Bangladesh and Hong Kong Sign Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement
bangladesh_hong_kong_ippa.summary: The new IPPA aims to boost bilateral investment, especially in garments and textiles, while enhancing legal safeguards for investors from both nations.
highlights: Hong Kong ranks as Bangladesh's seventh‑largest source of foreign direct investment.
Bangladesh has attracted roughly $750 million in Hong Kong FDI over the last five years, including $122 million in 2025.

floating_lng_assessment_2026.institution: Ministry of Power, Energy and Mineral Resources
floating_lng_assessment_2026.headline: Bangladesh Evaluates New Floating LNG Terminal to Boost Gas Supply
floating_lng_assessment_2026.summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman announced the government is assessing a new floating LNG terminal on the southwestern coast to expand import capacity and reduce industrial gas disruptions.
highlights: Potential sites include Payra or Mongla ports for the new floating terminal.
Kutubjom floating terminal aims to start regasified LNG deliveries in 2028, while Matarbari land‑based terminal targets 2030.
Government targets drilling 150 wells and conducting extensive seismic surveys by FY2030‑31.

oman_bangladesh_labour_agreement.headline: Bangladesh and Oman Explore Opening Omani Labour Market to Bangladeshi Workers
oman_bangladesh_labour_agreement.summary: Bangladesh and Oman discussed expanding economic ties by considering the entry of Bangladeshi workers into Oman’s labour market, highlighting mutual benefits for development.
highlights: Al Sayyid Mohammed Salim Ali Al Said praised Bangladeshi workers’ contribution to Oman's economy
State Minister Shama Obaed Islam led talks on strengthening Bangladesh‑Oman economic relations

dse_slips_cautious_investors.headline: DSE slips as investors stay cautious amid utility crisis
dse_slips_cautious_investors.summary: The Dhaka Stock Exchange edged lower, with turnover down 12% as gas and electricity shortages and regulatory uncertainty kept investors on the sidelines.
highlights: DSEX fell 1 point to close at 5,538
Turnover dropped to Tk520 crore, a 12% decline from the previous session
Textile stocks led turnover with a 31.2% share

rmg_firms_capital_market_financing.headline: Swisscontact to Guide Bangladesh RMG Firms into Capital Market Financing
rmg_firms_capital_market_financing.summary: Swisscontact will provide advisory and technical support to leading Bangladeshi ready‑made garment companies aiming to raise long‑term funds through the Dhaka Stock Exchange.
highlights: Swisscontact plans to develop several RMG firms as role models for capital‑market entry within a year.
Dhaka Stock Exchange will expand financing options beyond IPOs, emphasizing the bond market and SME‑board offerings.

vat_evasion_alpha_e_shop.headline: Alpha e Shop Caught Evading Tk 2 Crore in VAT
vat_evasion_alpha_e_shop.summary: The National Board of Revenue discovered that online retailer Alpha e Shop avoided roughly Tk 2 crore in VAT through complex multi‑channel sales.
highlights: Raids on Alpha e Shop’s Banani and Mirpur‑12 showrooms uncovered the tax shortfall.
The company sells via showrooms, website, phone, WhatsApp, and social‑media platforms, complicating VAT tracking.

bank_resolution_amendment_act.headline: Bangladesh Repeals Bank Resolution Clause Allowing Former Owners to Reclaim Banks
bank_resolution_amendment_act.summary: Parliament passed the Bank Resolution (Amendment) Act, scrapping Section 18A that let former directors repurchase merged banks by paying a 7.5% upfront fee.
highlights: Section 18A required a 7.5% upfront payment and 92.5% repayment with 10% simple interest over two years.
The amendment was approved by voice vote despite criticism that it could let looters regain ownership.

tk4cr_embezzlement_commercial_bank.headline: Bangladesh Commerce Bank loses Tk4 crore in fake hospitality expense scandal
tk4cr_embezzlement_commercial_bank.summary: Bangladesh Bank uncovered a Tk4 crore embezzlement at Bangladesh Commerce Bank, disguised as hospitality expenses, and ordered dismissal of two senior officials.
highlights: Tk4 crore was recorded as “hospitality expenses” to secure a Tk100 crore deposit from Gazipur City Corporation.
Thirteen officials received the money as “incentives,” later withdrawn in cash via 14 cheques.
Bangladesh Bank ordered dismissal of SEVP Delwar Hossain and SPO Hamidur Rahman.

fertiliser_stock_adequacy.headline: Bangladesh Government Claims Fertiliser Surplus Amid Opposition Allegations of Mismanagement
fertiliser_stock_adequacy.summary: The government reports a 1.584 million‑tonne fertiliser surplus for the upcoming Rabi and Boro seasons, while opposition blames dealer irregularities and poor management.
highlights: Demand of 3.587 million tonnes will be met by a prepared supply of 5.171 million tonnes, creating a surplus.
Opposition MPs allege black‑market sales and inflated prices, with some farmers paying up to Tk800 above official rates.

bankruptcy_action_chowdhury.headline: Ex‑Minister Saifuzzaman Chowdhury Faces UK Bankruptcy Petition Over £185 Million Property Freeze
bankruptcy_action_chowdhury.summary: Bangladeshi former land minister Saifuzzaman Chowdhury is being sued by SBAC Bank to be declared bankrupt after the UK National Crime Agency froze his family’s £185 million property portfolio.
highlights: SBAC Bank Plc filed a court petition in London's High Court seeking Chowdhury’s bankruptcy.
The National Crime Agency froze 342 properties worth about £185 million linked to Chowdhury and his family.
MFS, a collapsed UK bridging‑finance firm, had arranged loans on over 175 of those property transactions.

bangla_qr_abuse.headline: Abuse of Bangla QR Threatens Bangladesh’s Mobile Financial Services Ecosystem
bangla_qr_abuse.summary: Merchants and MFS agents are exploiting the zero‑fee Bangla QR platform to bypass cash‑out charges and limits, jeopardizing the sustainability of Bangladesh’s digital payments network.
highlights: Customers can move large sums via multiple QR payments, avoiding daily cash‑out caps of Tk30,000.
Average daily Bangla QR transaction value jumped from Tk37 crore to Tk110 crore within a month.
Zero Merchant Discount Rate and Interchange Reimbursement Fee removal pressure MFS providers’ revenue streams.

bd_indonesia_trade_ties.headline: Bangladesh seeks Comprehensive Economic Partnership with Indonesia, urges visa easing and trade boost
bd_indonesia_trade_ties.summary: Bangladesh’s foreign affairs minister announced readiness to deepen trade with Indonesia through a CEP, calling for easier visas, higher imports, and disaster‑management cooperation.
highlights: Indonesia’s ambassador pledged support for expanding Bangladeshi pharmaceutical exports
Bangladesh aims to become an ASEAN Sectoral Dialogue Partner and join the RCEP

loss_making_firms_policy.headline: Invest Bangladesh Proposes Policy to Transfer Loss‑Making State Enterprises
loss_making_firms_policy.summary: The draft policy seeks to revitalize idle state‑owned firms and unused land by moving them to transparent, competitive investment processes, aiming to boost production and jobs.
highlights: Policy drafted under Section 48 of the Invest Bangladesh Act 2026
Public consultation open until 17 September for comments in Bangla
Aims to attract domestic and foreign investors and create employment

capital_increase.headline: Pubali Bank proposes doubling authorised capital to Tk4,000 crore
capital_increase.summary: Pubali Bank's board recommends raising authorised capital to Tk4,000 crore, increasing shares to 400 crore, pending shareholder and Bangladesh Bank approval.
highlights: Authorized capital will be doubled to Tk4,000 crore.
Ordinary shares will rise to 400 crore with a Tk10 face value each.
EPS climbed to Tk4.39 for the January–June 2026 period.

defaulted_loans_concentration.headline: Ten Bangladeshi banks hold over 72% of Tk6 lakh cr crore defaulted loans
defaulted_loans_concentration.summary: At June end, ten banks accounted for more than 72% of the sector’s Tk6 lakh crore non‑performing loans, highlighting severe asset‑quality risks.
highlights: NPL ratio rose to 30.60% by December 2025, up from 20.20% a year earlier
Private Islami Bank recorded the highest NPL volume at Tk98,914 crore, 52.15% of its loan book
Bangladesh Bank is pursuing reforms, mergers and tighter credit supervision to curb the crisis

fertiliser_shortage_claims.headline: Farmers Claim Fertiliser Shortage Amid Government’s Assertion of Adequate Stocks
fertiliser_shortage_claims.summary: Farmers in Rajshahi, Kurigram and Naogaon report severe shortages of DAP and TSP, while officials cite sufficient buffer stocks and deny a national crisis.
highlights: DAP prices reported at Tk1,400 per sack versus the government‑set Tk1,050, and TSP at Tk2,000 versus Tk1,350.
Government warehouses hold over 10,000 tonnes of urea and several thousand tonnes of TSP and DAP, according to BCIC and BADC data.
Mobile courts have fined dealers and seized fertilizer shipments, recording 204 operations and Tk35 lakh in penalties in

dse_losing_streak.headline: DSE extends losing streak for third session, sheds 23 points
dse_losing_streak.summary: The Dhaka Stock Exchange fell 23 points as investors stayed cautious amid an energy crisis, regulatory scrutiny and an upcoming earnings season.
highlights: DSEX closed at 5,515 while DS30 slipped to 2,095
Turnover rose 5.61% to Tk544 crore despite broad‑based selling
Textile stocks led turnover at 24.7% but most sectors ended lower

finance_cost_reduction_fy26.headline: Walton slashes finance costs 60% as home appliances drive FY26 growth
finance_cost_reduction_fy26.summary: Walton posted 8% profit rise to Tk1,124 crore, boosted by 40% home‑appliance sales and a 60% cut in finance costs.
highlights: Finance costs fell 60% to Tk181 crore, reducing their share of sales to 2.45%.
Cable sales surged 85% to Tk247 crore, the fastest segment growth.

imf_chief_economist_candidate_change.headline: IMF Rejects Chief Economist Candidate After Trump Tariff Comments
imf_chief_economist_candidate_change.summary: The International Monetary Fund withdrew its leading nominee for chief economist after the candidate’s remarks on President Trump’s tariff policy sparked controversy.
highlights: The IMF said the candidate’s statements on U.S. tariffs were incompatible with its diplomatic stance
The withdrawal follows internal debate over political neutrality in senior appointments
The chief economist role remains vacant pending a new selection process

forexreserves36bnusd.headline: Bangladesh’s Gross Forex Reserves Hit $36.38 Billion, Surpassing IMF Safety Threshold
forexreserves36bnusd.summary: Bangladesh Bank reports gross foreign exchange reserves at $36.38 billion, providing roughly 4.8 months of import cover well above the IMF’s three‑month minimum.
highlights: Usable reserves under BPM6 total $31.47 billion, giving the central bank headroom to manage exchange‑rate volatility.
Monthly import bill peaks at $6.5 billion, meaning reserves cover about 4.8 months of imports.
Reserve level exceeds the IMF’s recommended minimum of three months.

auditfirmmandatory500cr.headline: Bangladesh Bank Mandates Audit Firms for Loans Over Tk500 crore
auditfirmmandatory500cr.summary: New Bangladesh Bank rules require internal audit verification for loans up to Tk500 crore and compulsory third‑party audit for any loan exceeding that threshold.
highlights: Loans between Tk100 crore and Tk500 crore must be verified by the bank’s internal audit or risk management unit
Loans of Tk500 crore or more need an external audit firm approved by Bangladesh Bank to examine fund utilisation
Banks must confirm proper use of each instalment before releasing the next for term and project loans

socialbondtk1000cr.headline: BRAC Bank Issues Bangladesh’s First Tk1,000 crore Social Bond
socialbondtk1000cr.summary: BRAC Bank completed Bangladesh’s inaugural Tk1,000 crore social bond, fully subscribed by 665 investors, directing funds to diverse social projects.
highlights: All 665 investors subscribed, including 593 individuals
Proceeds will boost Tier‑II capital under Basel III and fund SMEs, women‑owned businesses, agriculture, affordable housing

adani_power_supply_drop_bangladesh.headline: Adani Power Supply to Bangladesh Drops Below 800MW After Unit‑2 Shutdown
adani_power_supply_drop_bangladesh.summary: Technical failure at Adani’s Godda plant forced Unit‑2 offline, cutting Bangladesh’s imported power to under 800MW amid a growing supply‑demand gap.
highlights: Supply fell from 1,430MW to about 758MW after the shutdown
Bangladesh’s grid shortfall stands at 2,869MW as demand reaches 15,776MW
Repair of the boiler feed pump may take three to four days

food_price_spike_dhaka_sept_2026.headline: Flour and Aromatic Rice Prices Surge as Soybean Oil Shortage Persists
food_price_spike_dhaka_sept_2026.summary: Sharp price hikes in flour, maida and aromatic rice are straining bakeries, biryani outlets and middle‑income households amid ongoing soybean oil shortages.
highlights: Loose flour rose to Tk 50 per kg and maida to Tk 80‑85 per kg in Dhaka markets
Aromatic rice jumped to Tk 200 per kg after the Ministry of Commerce halved its export quota
Overall inflation was 8.26% in August while food inflation stood at 7.02%

pubali_bank_capital_hike_bb_requirement.headline: Pubali Bank to Double Capital to Meet Bangladesh Bank Dividend Rule
pubali_bank_capital_hike_bb_requirement.summary: Pubali Bank plans to raise its authorised capital to Tk 40 billion, aiming to meet Bangladesh Bank’s new cash‑dividend threshold for banks with paid‑up capital below Tk 20 billion.
highlights: The bank’s paid‑up capital of Tk 15.62 billion falls short of the Tk 20 billion requirement for cash dividends.
An extraordinary general meeting is set for October 25 to seek shareholder approval for the capital increase.
Other banks such as City Bank and Dutch‑Bangla Bank are also expanding authorised capital to comply with the new policy.

bessent_intervention_risk_boj_credibilit.headline: Scott Bessent’s push for BoJ market intervention threatens central bank credibility, warn bankers
bessent_intervention_risk_boj_credibilit.summary: Bankers caution that Scott Bessent’s urging of the Bank of Japan to intervene in the yen market could undermine the institution’s credibility and policy independence.
highlights: Bessent, chief investment officer at PIMCO, publicly urged the BoJ to act against yen weakness
Bankers fear such pressure may erode the BoJ’s reputation for autonomous monetary policy
The debate highlights tension between market participants and central bank independence

anthropic_stopped_bioweapon_ai_research.headline: Anthropic Halts AI Project Over Potential Bioweapon Development Risks
anthropic_stopped_bioweapon_ai_research.summary: Anthropic announced it stopped a research initiative after scientists raised concerns that its AI tools could be misused to design biological weapons.
highlights: Anthropic identified dual‑use risk in its generative‑AI platform
The decision follows internal review of scientists' ethical concerns
Company pledged tighter safeguards to prevent misuse

dhaka_ctg_highway_set_for_transformation.institution: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority / Dhaka‑Ctg Highway Authority
dhaka_ctg_highway_set_for_transformation.headline: AI Surveillance and New Infrastructure Transform Dhaka‑Chattogram Highway
dhaka_ctg_highway_set_for_transformation.summary: Bangladesh launches AI‑powered traffic monitoring and plans a 10‑lane upgrade to cut accidents and congestion on the 232‑km Dhaka‑Chattogram highway.
highlights: 1,427 AI cameras will be installed at 490 points to detect speeding, lane violations and illegal parking.
Within the first 24 hours of launch, 449 violations were recorded and fines totaling Tk15.51 lakh were imposed.
A feasibility study is underway to expand the highway to 10 lanes with additional underpasses and overpasses.

fta_understanding_with_eu_before_graduat.headline: Bangladesh to Seek EU Free Trade Deal Before LDC Graduation
fta_understanding_with_eu_before_graduat.summary: Commerce Minister Khandaker Abdul Muktadir announced that Bangladesh will start EU FTA negotiations, aiming to secure trade benefits before losing LDC status in 2029.
highlights: EU FTA talks to begin soon, targeting agreement before 2029 LDC graduation
Bangladesh's logistics costs equal 16% of GDP, above the 10% global average
Plans to digitise customs and cut business start‑up time to 14 days

maitree_express_relaunch_through_padma_b.headline: India Proposes Rerouting Maitree Express via Bangladesh's Padma Bridge
maitree_express_relaunch_through_padma_b.summary: Bangladesh may approve the Maitree Express passenger train to run over the new Padma Bridge if India submits a formal diplomatic proposal, officials said.
highlights: India’s railway board leader Deepak Kumar Jha confirmed willingness to route the train via Padma Bridge.
The proposed reroute could cut travel time by two to three hours.
Final approval requires a formal proposal from India and top‑level government consent in Bangladesh.

us_diesel_price_record_iran_shock.headline: US diesel hits record $6 a gallon amid Iran supply shock
us_diesel_price_record_iran_shock.summary: US diesel prices surged to a historic $6 per gallon as Iranian supply disruptions tighten the market and push fuel costs higher.
highlights: Retail diesel reached $6 per gallon, the highest level on record
Iranian crude shortages reduced refinery output, tightening US diesel supply

iea_lost_period_oil_demand.headline: IEA Warns of a ‘Lost Period’ as Global Oil Demand Stalls
iea_lost_period_oil_demand.summary: The International Energy Agency says oil demand could plateau this decade, creating a lost growth period that may reshape markets and investment strategies.
highlights: IEA forecasts global oil demand to peak by 2027 and then decline slowly
The agency cites slower economic growth and accelerating energy transition as key drivers
Potential oversupply could pressure prices and accelerate shift to renewables

padma_barrage_construction_to_begin_betw.headline: Padma Barrage Construction to Start Early 2027, Aiming to Tame Floods
padma_barrage_construction_to_begin_betw.summary: The seven‑year Padma Barrage, approved by the NEC, will begin early 2027 to alleviate monsoon flooding, river erosion and dry‑season salinity across 24 districts.
highlights: Construction includes a Gorai River offtake channel and a year‑round hydropower plant.
Project benefits will extend to the Hisna River basin in Daulatpur upazila.

utilise_bhola_gas_to_drive_industrialisa.headline: Bhola Gas to Power Barishal’s Industrialisation Push
utilise_bhola_gas_to_drive_industrialisa.summary: Speakers urged using Bhola’s gas and improving infrastructure to transform Barishal into a major industrial hub and attract new investment.
highlights: Barishal’s industrial contribution is currently below 2% of national output.
A southern economic corridor centred on Payra Deep Sea Port was proposed.
Recommendations include gas‑powered industrial zones, cold‑chain facilities, and upgraded road and waterway networks.

how_old_jeans_find_new_life_in_upcycled_.headline: Bangladesh Denim Upcycling Turns Waste into Sustainable Fashion
how_old_jeans_find_new_life_in_upcycled_.summary: Bangladeshi startups Baah and Bidora upcycle surplus and post‑consumer denim into bags and apparel, cutting water use while confronting regulatory import bans.
highlights: Denim exports reached $2.6 billion last year
Upcycled products generate about ten lakh taka per month through Facebook commerce
Government policy restricts import of used garments, limiting local waste streams

use_of_anthropic_ai_for_ballistic_missil.headline: Houthis Turn to Anthropic AI in Quest to Build Ballistic Missiles
use_of_anthropic_ai_for_ballistic_missil.summary: The Yemen‑based Houthis have employed Anthropic’s artificial‑intelligence tools in an effort to design and develop new ballistic missile capabilities.
highlights: Anthropic AI was accessed by Houthi engineers to model missile components
The initiative reflects a broader trend of non‑state actors leveraging advanced AI for weapons
U.S. and allied intelligence agencies are monitoring the AI‑driven missile program closely

chattogram_customs_backlog_tk2_661cr.headline: Chattogram Customs Faces Tk2,661 crore Revenue Blocked by 10,459 Litigation Cases
chattogram_customs_backlog_tk2_661cr.summary: A backlog of 10,459 customs cases in Chattogram ties up over Tk 2,661 crore in disputed revenue, straining limited resources and delaying imports.
highlights: 656 new cases were filed in FY26, adding Tk 1,094.87 crore to the backlog.
Twenty high‑value cases involve Tk 135.03 crore, with the largest dispute from Akij Shipping Lines Ltd at Tk 18.25 crore.

signature_forgery_tk1cr_loan.headline: Six Islami Bank officials forged signatures to create Tk1.03 crore loan, leaving importer burdened
signature_forgery_tk1cr_loan.summary: Investigation found six Islami Bank Khulshi officials forged importer Nurul Huda’s signature to open letters of credit and Mudaraba loans totaling Tk1.03 crore, leaving him with Tk87.15 lakh debt.
highlights: The forged loans remain largely unpaid, with Tk87.15 lakh still outstanding.
CID forensic analysis confirmed signature mismatches on the loan documents.
Nine individuals were charged, and three were later sought to be discharged by the CID.

property_law_amendment_lifetime_deed_sec.institution: Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs
property_law_amendment_lifetime_deed_sec.headline: Bangladesh Amends Property Law to Secure Lifetime Rights for Elderly Donors
property_law_amendment_lifetime_deed_sec.summary: The new Transfer of Property (Amendment) Bill 2026 introduces a gift with reserved life interest, protecting seniors’ occupancy and income rights.
highlights: Section 122A allows parents to retain residence, use and rental income for life after gifting property.
Section 122B makes the gift irrevocable except by mutual deed or court approval, preventing unilateral eviction.

patenga_terminal_productivity.headline: RSGT Bangladesh Hits 58 Moves per Hour at Patenga Terminal
patenga_terminal_productivity.summary: RSGT Bangladesh achieved a record 58 container moves and 82 TEUs per hour using new ship‑to‑shore cranes at Patenga, nearly double historic rates.
highlights: The gearless vessel MV WANEN was handled in the terminal’s first gear‑less operation.
CEO Erwin Haaze said the gains could cut vessel turnaround time and lower costs.
New ship‑to‑shore (STS) cranes were central to the productivity increase.

british_era_trade_controls.headline: Bangladesh’s Legacy Import‑Export Certificates Stifle Trade, Officials Seek Deregulation
british_era_trade_controls.summary: Businesses face costly, duplicated paperwork through IRC and ERC licences, prompting the commerce ministry to review the 1950 Import and Export (Control) Act for reform.
highlights: IRC fees start at Tk5,000 and can rise to Tk80,000, with renewal fees up to Tk32,000.
Only 14 chief controller offices issue certificates, forcing firms to travel for compliance.
Regional peers like China and Vietnam operate without separate import‑export certificates.

measles_deaths_update.headline: Bangladesh Measles Death Toll Reaches 1,019 as Seven Children Die in One Day
measles_deaths_update.summary: The combined confirmed and suspected measles deaths in Bangladesh rose to 1,019 this year after seven more children died within a 24‑hour period.
highlights: Suspected deaths climbed to 919 while confirmed deaths stand at 100.
New suspected cases total 170,638 and confirmed infections reach 20,006.

aircraft_lease_order.headline: US-Bangla Airlines to Lease $4‑5 Billion of Aircraft Within 60 Days
aircraft_lease_order.summary: US-Bangla Airlines announced a $4‑5 billion lease order to expand its fleet, though details on aircraft count and manufacturer remain undisclosed.
highlights: The airline currently operates 25 aircraft, the largest fleet among Bangladeshi carriers.
Earlier, US-Bangla secured a $1.5 billion lease for 21 Boeing 737‑8 and 737‑800 jets slated for delivery by 2027.

bsec_capital_market_appeal.headline: BSEC Chairman Calls for More Companies to List and Reduce Bank Dependence
bsec_capital_market_appeal.summary: Masud Khan urged quality firms to join Bangladesh’s capital market, aiming to boost trading volume and shift long‑term financing away from banks.
highlights: Daily trading volume ratio is only 0.14% of market capitalisation, lagging behind regional peers
BSEC plans to adopt international‑style book‑building and explore IPO and direct‑listing options
Developing debt instruments like long‑term bonds and mutual funds is needed to finance large projects

high_tech_parks_performance.headline: Bangladesh’s High‑Tech Parks Miss Investment Targets Amid Ecosystem Gaps
high_tech_parks_performance.summary: Despite building 39 parks since 2009, Bangladesh has failed to attract expected investment, skilled jobs, and thriving tech firms due to weak ecosystem support.
highlights: Only 40 companies operate in Jashore High‑Tech Park, many struggling without adequate support.
Rajshahi Hi‑Tech Park’s incubation centre has produced firms that now export, but tax breaks remain the main benefit.
High utility costs and poor maintenance deter companies, leading some to abandon allocated land in Kaliakoir Park.

india_regulator_proposes_changes_to_clos.institution: Securities and Exchange Board of India
india_regulator_proposes_changes_to_clos.headline: SEBI Proposes Overhaul of India’s Closing Auction Amid Recent Market Swings
india_regulator_proposes_changes_to_clos.summary: India’s securities regulator SEBI announced a plan to revamp the closing auction mechanism to curb volatility and improve price discovery after recent sharp swings.
highlights: The proposal includes tighter price bands and a new volatility trigger for the closing auction
Market participants will receive extended order‑entry windows to enhance liquidity
SEBI seeks to align the auction rules with global best practices

brics_adopts_joint_declaration_urges_max.headline: BRICS Leaders Issue Joint Declaration Calling for Maximum Restraint in Middle East
brics_adopts_joint_declaration_urges_max.summary: At the New Delhi summit, BRICS heads urged all parties to exercise maximum restraint amid escalating tensions, emphasizing diplomatic dialogue over conflict.
highlights: BRICS leaders signed a joint declaration on September 12, 2026
The statement was issued by Putin, Xi Jinping, Modi, and Indonesia’s President Prabowo Subianto
The declaration calls for restraint and urges a return to diplomatic negotiations

foreign_capital_flight_august.headline: Foreign Investors Pull Back From Bangladesh Stocks Despite New Incentives
foreign_capital_flight_august.summary: In August, foreign investors sold large stakes in major Bangladeshi banks and blue‑chip firms, overriding recent regulatory incentives aimed at attracting overseas capital.
highlights: City Bank foreign ownership fell to 8.26%, a Tk90 crore sell‑off, the steepest decline among listed firms.
Bangladesh Bank removed auditor‑certificate requirements and allowed direct tax withholding into NITA accounts, while BSEC eased
MSCI will end its three‑year special‑treatment of Bangladesh indices in November 2026, resuming regular reviews.

dsex_plunge_energy_earnings.headline: DSEX slides 146 points amid energy shortages and earnings worries
dsex_plunge_energy_earnings.summary: Bangladesh’s bourse fell sharply as persistent energy shortages and weakening corporate earnings eroded investor confidence, wiping out roughly Tk5,400 crore in market value.
highlights: DSEX closed at 5,515, down 2.59%
Blue‑chip DS30 fell 2.12% to 2,095
Daily turnover slipped 9% to Tk554 crore

navana_cng_share_confiscation.headline: BSEC Approves Bangladesh Finance’s Confiscation of Navana CNG Shares
navana_cng_share_confiscation.summary: Bangladesh Finance secured regulatory clearance to seize 22.87 lakh Navana CNG shares pledged for Tk53.87 crore loans, after prolonged defaults.
highlights: Total outstanding loan is Tk53.87 crore, with Tk29.76 crore overdue.
Pledged shares are valued at roughly Tk4.64 crore, far below the loan amount.
BSEC’s approval follows Navana CNG’s downgrade to Z‑category, which previously blocked share transfer.

push_for_gulf_peace.headline: BRICS Urge Gulf Peace Amid Growing War Concerns Over Trade Routes
push_for_gulf_peace.summary: BRICS nations are pressing for stability in the Gulf region as escalating conflicts threaten key maritime trade corridors and energy supplies.
highlights: BRICS leaders highlighted the risk to oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz
They called for diplomatic efforts to de‑escalate regional tensions
The bloc warned that prolonged conflict could disrupt global trade flows

us_investment_target_5b.institution: American Chamber of Commerce in Bangladesh
us_investment_target_5b.headline: Bangladesh Targets Extra $5 Billion US Investment Over Next Five Years
us_investment_target_5b.summary: Commerce Minister Khandakar Abdul Muktadir announced a joint effort with AmCham to attract an additional $5 billion in U.S. investment, aiming to boost jobs and technology transfer.
highlights: Bilateral trade between Bangladesh and the United States already exceeds $13 billion.
AmCham member companies have invested over $5 billion in Bangladesh, contributing more than 20 % of national revenue.
The government plans to simplify procedures, expand digitalisation and improve trade facilitation to create an

london_trade_centre.institution: British Bangladesh Chamber of Commerce and Industry (BBCCCI)
london_trade_centre.headline: British-Bangladesh Trade Centre to Boost UK-Bangladesh Business Ties
london_trade_centre.summary: The British Bangladesh Chamber of Commerce and Industry will launch a London-based trade centre aimed at linking firms, fostering investment and expanding bilateral commerce.
highlights: BBCCCI will establish the British-Bangladesh Trade Centre in London.
The centre will provide programmes for trade, investment, entrepreneurship and joint‑venture support.
Acting High Commissioner M Nazrul Islam highlighted the initiative at the launch event.

insurance_claims_settlement_tk23cr.headline: IDRA Clears Tk23.03 crore in Long‑Pending Claims for 5,868 Policyholders
insurance_claims_settlement_tk23cr.summary: The Insurance Development and Regulatory Authority is disbursing Tk23.03 crore to 5,868 policyholders in the second phase of its claim settlement programme, aiming to restore confidence.
highlights: Second phase covers five life insurers, totaling Tk23.03 crore
Padma Islami Life Insurance will pay about Tk12 crore to 3,600 policyholders

trump_ireland_commentary.headline: Trump declares a united Ireland inevitable and “a very cool thing”
trump_ireland_commentary.summary: Former President Donald Trump said the prospect of a united Ireland is unavoidable and expressed enthusiasm for the idea in recent remarks.
highlights: Trump described a united Ireland as inevitable and a very cool thing
The comment reflects personal opinion, not an official policy stance
No immediate political actions were announced following the statement

farmer_card_incentive.headline: Bangladesh Launches Farmer Card Pilot, 110,364 Farmers to Receive Incentives
farmer_card_incentive.summary: The government will give each of the 110,364 registered farmers Tk2,500 under the pilot Farmer Card scheme, aiming to expand to over 20 million farmers nationwide.
highlights: Pilot programme distributes Tk2,500 to 110,364 farmers
Expansion target of more than 20 million farmers across all upazilas
Government monitors fertiliser irregularities with zero‑tolerance policy

tbsnews.net/worldbiz/asia/south-koreas-e.headline: South Korea Enacts Broad Espionage Law to Guard Chip Technology
tbsnews.net/worldbiz/asia/south-koreas-e.summary: The revised Criminal Act, effective Sept 13, expands espionage offences to all foreign actors, aiming to protect strategic sectors like semiconductors and AI.
highlights: New offence carries a minimum three‑year prison term for spying for any foreign state or organization.
Law closes the loophole that previously limited espionage charges to North Korea, strengthening deterrence for semiconductor
The high‑profile DRAM leak case involving former Samsung staff underscored the need for stronger penalties.

tbsnews.net/world/test-all-eyes-us-fed-t.headline: US Fed Faces Crucial Test as Inflation Persists Amid Political Pressure
tbsnews.net/world/test-all-eyes-us-fed-t.summary: The Federal Reserve is expected to raise rates this week to curb 3.4% consumer inflation, despite President Trump's attacks on the central bank’s independence.
highlights: Rate hike probability exceeds 85% according to CME FedWatch
Current policy rate sits between 3.50% and 3.75%

korea_tests_longer_trading_hours_to_attr.headline: South Korea Extends Stock Exchange Hours to Attract Global Investors
korea_tests_longer_trading_hours_to_attr.summary: The Korea Exchange will add evening trading sessions starting next month, aiming to boost liquidity and draw foreign capital despite concerns over market volatility.
highlights: Evening sessions will run from 5 p.m. to 8 p.m. local time, extending the current market schedule.
The extension targets increased foreign investor participation and higher daily trading volumes.

chevron_meeting_pm_on_gas_investment.headline: Chevron seeks expanded gas investments in Bangladesh, meets PM
chevron_meeting_pm_on_gas_investment.summary: Chevron's senior delegation met Prime Minister Tarique Rahman to discuss boosting investment in existing and new gas fields as Bangladesh aims to increase domestic production.
highlights: Chevron delegation led by Javier La Rosa discussed expanding stakes in mature gas fields
The meeting included senior officials such as Dr Rashed Al Mahmud Titumir and State Minister Aninda Islam Amit
Bangladesh is actively courting foreign investors to meet rising energy demand

court_freezes_tk786cr_in_shares.headline: Bangladesh Court Freezes Tk786 crore in Nagad‑Linked Shares
court_freezes_tk786cr_in_shares.summary: A Dhaka court ordered the freezing of shares worth Tk786 crore held by former Third Wave Technologies director and others amid an ACC probe into massive fund diversion.
highlights: The ACC alleges diversion of unused government allowance funds through Nagad to 24,159 fake entrepreneur wallets.
Preliminary investigation uncovered embezzlement of Tk1,706 crore, with proceeds used to buy shares now frozen.

president_urges_stronger_bangladesh_paki.headline: President Calls for Stronger Bangladesh-Pakistan Trade and Education Ties
president_urges_stronger_bangladesh_paki.summary: President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir urged deeper bilateral trade, investment, and educational cooperation with Pakistan, highlighting opportunities in garments, tea, ceramics, and air links.
highlights: A trade fair showcasing Pakistani products will be held in Dhka in October.
Direct flights between Dhaka and Karachi have resumed, boosting trade and medical tourism.
Bangladesh aims to increase tea exports to Pakistan using a duty‑free facility.

hormuz_standoff_meeting.headline: UAE and Iran Leaders Convene to Defuse Hormuz Standoff
hormuz_standoff_meeting.summary: UAE President Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan met Iranian envoy Masoud Pezeshkian to discuss de‑escalation of tensions in the strategic Strait of Hormuz.
highlights: Both sides expressed willingness to resume dialogue
The meeting follows recent naval incidents near the strait

ai_warning_chips.headline: Anthropic AI Warning Could Pressure Semiconductor Stocks, Trade Remains Steady
ai_warning_chips.summary: Anthropic’s caution about AI model costs may trigger a short‑term sell‑off in chip makers, though overall trade flows are expected to stay unchanged.
highlights: Semiconductor shares linked to AI could see an initial dip following Anthropic’s cost concerns
Analysts predict no major disruption to global chip trade despite the warning

ai_slowdown_call.headline: Altman and Musk Join Amodei in Urging Global AI Development Slowdown
ai_slowdown_call.summary: OpenAI’s Sam Altman and Elon Musk publicly back Dario Amodei’s plea for a coordinated pause on advanced AI systems to mitigate emerging risks.
highlights: Altman and Musk endorse Amodei’s call for an industry‑wide AI development moratorium
The proposal urges regulators to impose a temporary halt on models beyond a certain capability threshold
Amodei warns that unchecked progress could outpace safety measures and governance

importpolicyguidance2026_2029.headline: Bangladesh Bank Guides AD Banks on New Import Policy Order
importpolicyguidance2026_2029.summary: Bangladesh Bank issued guidelines allowing industrial and commercial imports without letters of credit, while ensuring compliance with foreign exchange rules through authorised dealer banks.
highlights: Import Policy Order 2026-2029 permits purchases without LCs for all permissible industrial and commercial goods.
Export‑oriented firms can source inputs locally via back‑to‑back LCs or free‑of‑cost arrangements, with bonded warehouse options.

backtobacklcreview.headline: Garment Accessories Makers Urge Bangladesh Bank to Streamline Back‑to‑Back LCs
backtobacklcreview.summary: The Chattogram Garments Accessories Association is pressing Bangladesh Bank to simplify back‑to‑back letter of credit procedures that delay payments and strain working capital for deemed exporters.
highlights: Repeated document approvals force exporters to route paperwork through garment factories before banks can process payments.
The association proposes allowing direct submission of documents to banks and removing unnecessary party acceptance steps.
It seeks UCP 600‑compliant guidelines to eliminate duplicate verification and discrepancy fees.

24_7operation.headline: Chattogram Customs Goes 24/7 to Accelerate Import Clearance
24_7operation.summary: Chattogram Customs House will run assessment and clearance services around the clock, including holidays, to speed up import releases and protect Bangladesh’s supply chain.
highlights: Customs assessment will operate 24/7, even on Fridays, Saturdays and public holidays.
The change aims to prevent delays and keep a steady flow of goods through Chattogram Port.

5bn_funding_round.headline: China’s Z.AI Secures $5 Billion Through Share Placement and Convertible Bond Sale
5bn_funding_round.summary: Beijing‑based AI firm Z.AI Co Ltd raised roughly $5 billion by issuing new shares and a $3 billion convertible bond in Hong Kong.
highlights: Share placement generated about $2 billion
Convertible bond issuance added roughly $3 billion
The fundraising totals $5 billion for Z.AI

us_investment_plan_details.headline: South Korea Moves to Finalise $350 Billion US Investment Plan This Week
us_investment_plan_details.summary: South Korean Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan announced talks to lock in a $350 billion commitment, including a $200 billion ceiling for strategic investments in the United States.
highlights: South Korea proposes a total $350 billion investment commitment to the US
A $200 billion ceiling is set for strategic investment projects
Minister Kim Jung-kwan will hold further talks early this week to finalize details

dsex_drop_energy_crisis.headline: DSEX Slides 96 Points Amid Energy Crisis and Middle East Tensions
dsex_drop_energy_crisis.summary: Bangladesh’s stock market fell 1.7% this week as power shortages and escalating Middle East conflict spooked investors, driving a broad sell‑off across all sectors.
highlights: DSEX closed at 5,418, its lowest in three months
Average daily turnover rose 5% to Tk571 crore despite the price decline
Travel stocks led losses, dropping 5.4%, while textiles accounted for 25.9% of turnover

biannual_md_ceo_reviews.headline: Bangladesh Bank launches bi‑annual performance reviews for bank MDs and CEOs
biannual_md_ceo_reviews.summary: The central bank introduced a six‑month KPI framework assessing solvency, asset quality, governance, customer conduct and profitability of bank leaders.
highlights: Scores are graded on a 100‑point scale, with below 65 triggering warnings or possible removal.
The framework allocates 25 points each to solvency, asset quality and governance, and includes about 30 specific indicators such

ship_recycling_skill_support.headline: South Korea pledges $15 Million to Boost Bangladesh Ship‑Recycling Workforce
ship_recycling_skill_support.summary: South Korea’s Koica will fund a $15 million training programme from 2027‑2031 to develop skilled workers for Bangladesh’s ship‑recycling, shipbuilding and maintenance sectors.
highlights: Project targets modern technology, advanced welding and curriculum upgrades at the Bangladesh‑Korea Technical Training Centre.
Study shows only 1‑2% of required workers possess needed skills, prompting expanded training across related maritime sectors.
Korean ship recycling firms aim to source ships from Bangladeshi yards, linking the initiative to future investment.

new_attacks_hormuz_oil_disruption.headline: New Attacks in Hormuz and Saudi Heighten Oil Disruption Risks
